test.name: Indexed name search should not trigger search-images
test.description: User wants an indexed name/date/place search of the census. That's search-records — search-images is for browsing UNINDEXED digitized volumes page-by-page, not running indexed queries. The volume-search-any / image-search-any mcp_fixtures are declared deliberately and must NOT be removed as unused (#1788): they advertise the browse tools so a forbidden browse lands in tool_calls where the no-browse-on-indexed invariant can catch it.

input.user_message: Search the 1850 U.S. census index for Patrick Flynn in Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania.

negative.explanation: This is an indexed search by name/date/place — exactly what search-records does. search-images browses unindexed image volumes one page at a time; it should not be used when an index exists.

judge_context: Should route to search-records rather than browsing images — an indexed census query does not require paging through a digitized volume.

The no-browse-on-indexed invariant is the deterministic gate here: a volume_search/image_search call, or a new log entry whose tool names one of them, fails the run regardless of how the prose reads. A log entry from search-records itself (tool: record_search) is the CORRECT route working and is not a violation.

The volume-search-any / image-search-any mcp_fixtures are deliberate and must NOT be removed as unused (#1788): they advertise volume_search and image_search so a forbidden browse actually lands in tool_calls where the invariant can catch it. Without them the mock offers neither tool, the browse can never be recorded, and the invariant passes vacuously. They are catch-alls returning empty results, so they do not make a browse look successful.
